title: 12.10 Joint Ventures – Core Principles of Strategic Marketing

facts.fact: A joint venture is defined on the page as a business agreement in which parties agree to develop a new entity and new assets by contributing equity, and they share revenues, expenses and assets.
facts.quote: A joint venture is a business agreement in which parties agree to develop a new entity and new assets by contributing equity.

facts.fact: The page defines a joint venture term as a cooperative partnership between two individuals or businesses in which profits and risks are shared.
facts.quote: A cooperative partnership between two individuals or businesses in which profits and risks are shared.

facts.fact: The Vitrac joint venture between Abdel Nour's company and the French firm Vitrac continued for three years before the French company sold its shares to Abdel Nour.
facts.quote: The two companies’ joint venture continued for three years, until the French company sold its shares to Abdel Nour

facts.fact: Abdel Nour's Egyptian jam company reached $22 million in sales, per the page's case description.
facts.quote: Abdel Nour’s company reached $22 million in sales and was the Egyptian jam-market leader

facts.fact: The Chinese government began allowing equity joint ventures with foreign companies in 1979.
facts.quote: The Chinese government began to allow equity joint ventures in 1979

facts.fact: Prior to 1986, foreign companies could not wholly own a local subsidiary in China.
facts.quote: prior to 1986, foreign companies could not wholly own a local subsidiary.

facts.fact: As of 2010, equity joint ventures between a Chinese company and a foreign partner required the foreign partner to hold a minimum equity investment of at least 33 to 70 percent, with no minimum set for the Chinese partner.
facts.quote: require a minimum equity investment by the foreign partner of at least 33 to 70 percent of the equity

facts.fact: Shanghai Automotive Industry (Group) Corporation, per the page, planned to increase sales of its own vehicles tenfold to 300,000 in five years, competing with its former GM partner.
facts.quote: has pursued plans to increase sales of its own vehicles tenfold to 300,000 in five years

facts.fact: A consortium joint venture is dissolved once its goal is reached, according to the page.
facts.quote: The JV is dissolved when that goal is reached.
